title: When are meals served, and how do duties like meal preparation or cleanup work?

segments.text: To ensure everyone is well-fed, hydrated, and comfortable while maintaining cleanliness and harmony throughout the Mahotsav: Drinking Water Availability: Water coolers providing both normal and cold drinking water are available on-site, so you do not need to purchase water bottles from outside. ​Tea & Coffee Availability: A tea and coffee vending machine is conveniently located in the reception/dining area. You do not need to worry about getting your early morning or evening cup—it is readily accessible right there. ​Strict Pure Vegetarian Policy: Only 100% pure vegetarian food is permitted on the premises. Meat and non-vegetarian items are strictly prohibited inside. Any non-vegetarian meals must be consumed entirely outside Ashaeiynn grounds. ​Sponsored & Community Meals: During Mahotsav, generous devotees often sponsor bulk meals out of service (Seva). So you need not worry about food during the event. However, as these meals are usually ordered in bulk from restaurants, they may not suit everyone with strict dietary requirements. If you would like to sponsor a meal, please speak with your assigned mentor to select a specific day and coordinate your contribution. ​Tiffin Services & Delivery: If you prefer home-cooked style food or have specific dietary restrictions, local tiffin services are a great option (volunteers can guide you). Food delivery apps like Zomato and Swiggy are also available. ​Utensils & Kitchen Etiquette: ​The ashaeiynn kitchen is fully stocked with all the plates and utensils you will need—there is no need to bring your own utensils. ​Please wash your own plates and utensils in the kitchen immediately after eating and return them to their proper place. ​Nearby Dining Options: ​Hotel Green Beach: Located right next to ashaeiynn within walking distance—ideal if you need an early breakfast or prefer dining outside. ​Nearby Restaurants: If you have a vehicle, options like Haveli are located just a few kilometers away. ​Personal Snacks & Pest Control: You are welcome to bring personal vegetarian snacks. However, to prevent rodents and pests, all edible items must be stored securely in air-tight containers inside your luggage. ​Cleanliness & Dining Space: All meals, snacks, beverages, and prasad must be consumed exclusively in the designated dining/reception area—never in sleeping halls, luggage rooms, or sacred ritual spaces. Please always clean up your eating space after use.
